status_html: Research preview · figures to 31 August 2026, updated 18 October 2026. Real figures and estimates from public sources, not yet reviewed by a person. Every number has a likely range and a source; gaps are filled with estimates, never left at zero. Method and data: GitHub. Corrections: Reddit or a GitHub issue.

trade.name: UN Comtrade, IMF trade statistics and Eurostat: goods trade with Russia and Ukraine
trade.note: own reports first, then partner (mirror) reports, IMF and estimates; 2026 is January to August

nonreport.name: Trade with Russia for partners that do not report (Cuba, Venezuela, Syria, Libya, Iran...): tanker tracking, official statements
nonreport.note: Russian supplies given on credit or as aid are Russian support, not money to Russia: only the paid share counts

kiel.name: Kiel Institute, Ukraine Support Tracker Release 31 (published 8 Oct 2026)

kiel_eu_share.name: EU-level aid split over member states by their contribution to the EU budget (Kiel method)

aid_gaps.name: Aid from countries outside the Kiel tracker: UN OCHA Financial Tracking Service and government reports
aid_gaps.note: countries with no record: 0, with a small upper bound based on what similar donors gave

refugees.name: Refugee hosting cost: national budget figures where reported, otherwise refugees hosted per year x cost per refugee calibrated on those budgets
refugees.note: Eurostat and UNHCR counts, US and Canadian programme arrivals; see research/2026-10/gaps/refugees-notes.md

energy.name: Energy switching cost, oil discounts and laundered oil: modelled per fuel from CREA, Eurostat, Comtrade and market prices

transit_gas.name: Russian gas by country of final use (Eurostat imports by origin, ENTSOG flows, CREA), passed on from transit countries
transit_gas.note: replaces the gas in customs data (UN Comtrade HS 2711, research/2026-10/gaps/customs_gas.json) and in the fossil fuel tracker; see energy2-notes.md; Austria, Switzerland and Hungary 2024 are estimates

laundered.name: Laundered oil: fuel made from Russian crude, assigned to the final buyer (trading hubs pass on what they resell), valued at the Russian crude inside it
laundered.note: hub resale shares are estimates; hub customers from UN Comtrade HS 2710 exports 2024; crude content 60-75% of the fuel value

companies.name: KSE Institute and B4Ukraine: all taxes paid in Russia by foreign-owned companies, by home country
companies.note: reported for about 20 countries, allocated by company counts and investment for the rest; companies sold to Russian owners are not counted

services.name: Services trade with Russia (tourism, transport, business services): Eurostat, OECD-WTO BaTiS, Bank of Russia

hidden.name: Gold and hidden payment channels to Russia not in customs data: Swissaid, Reuters, Hong Kong and Kyrgyz trade gaps

undisclosed.name: Undisclosed military aid beyond the Kiel tracker: Kiel policy briefs, national reports

private.name: Private donations to Ukraine: national donation totals (DZI, DEC, Candid) and a GDP-based model elsewhere

flowback_model.name: Own-industry share of military aid: modelled range from procurement evidence
flowback_model.note: no government except the US publishes this share

csis.name: CSIS, Where is the missing $100 billion in US aid for Ukraine

purl.name: Kiel Policy Brief 203 and Ukrainian government, NATO PURL purchases

flowback_default.name: Assumed own-industry share 20-70% (middle 40%) where no evidence was found

flowback_kiel.name: Own-industry share of military aid from Kiel's item-level coding (own stocks, domestic purchases, purchases abroad)
flowback_kiel.note: stocks refilled at home and items with no coded source are estimated per donor; see research/2026-10/gaps/flowback2-notes.md

eu_industry.name: EU-level military aid spent with each member's arms industry: Kiel item coding and SIPRI Top 100 production shares

other_mil.name: Military support to Russia: estimates from KIDA, INSS, Bloomberg and others
other_mil.note: rough indication, certainty D; mostly paid for by Russia

other_mil2.name: Military support to Russia: INSS, KIDA, Bloomberg, Ukrainian and Western intelligence, own valuation for Belarus
other_mil2.note: rough indication, certainty D; China left out because it overlaps trade data

people.name: Volunteers and recruited fighters: compiled estimates

reexports.name: Re-exports through trade hubs (UAE, Armenia, Kazakhstan, Turkey, Kyrgyzstan and others): UN Comtrade re-export flags and matched product trade
reexports.note: UAE and Georgia from their own re-export records; other hubs estimated per product chapter with hub shares; see research/2026-10/gaps/reexports-notes.md

residual.name: GDP gaps (UNSD, UN WPP, CEPAL), Russia's import gap by country of origin, Hong Kong gold composition
